drafted_from: tool:keep-service-usage-watches's own row and test/service-watch.test.mjs, whose runs answered the states shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep a usage watch called usage on service_connection:cloudflare:one for 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28, read every 5 minutes." It runs tool:keep-service-usage-watches, which saves the watch in your records and reads it with tool:read-service-usage at each due wake.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: each watch is a service-watch record in your own records, read back with tool:read-saved-service-watches.
instructions: 1. Configure: operation configure with watch_id, connection_id, since, until and every_minutes.
2. Switch its wake on; each due wake runs operation wake, which reads the connection with tool:read-service-usage and saves the reading.
3. Read the saved state with tool:read-saved-service-watches { watch_id }.
4. Pause or delete with operation pause or delete and the exact expected snapshot the last answer gave.
